svg.text: MEX Game (2271B) — animated walkthrough · k = 2, so 2k = 4
Frame 1 — Count the cards, find m
m = the first value whose count is below 2k = 4
Frame 2 — YES: the 2k − 1 value splits lopsidedly
Any way the cards are taken, one hand drops below k = 2 at m
one hand has 1 < k → mex differ → ALICE WINS
Frame 3 — NO: Bob mirrors every pick
Alice takes a value, Bob copies it · splits stay even · both stop at m
both hands < k at m → mex equal → BOB WINS

text.font-family: 'Segoe Script','Bradley Hand','Lucida Handwriting','Brush Script MT','Comic Sans MS',cursive
